Do NOT re-derive the REVOKE — it exists. Two residues remain and are what review should check: (1) RE-GRANT FOOTGUN — the blanket GRANT ... ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_rls at 0037_rls_user_isolation.sql:81 would silently re-grant UPDATE/DELETE with no failing test, so reject any new blanket grant and treat the deferred BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger as the durable fix; (2) delete_user_data(text) is now SECURITY DEFINER with EXECUTE still open to public, so any grantee can purge any user's audit rows by p_user_id until EXECUTE is narrowed to the GDPR job role. See known-flaws AUDIT-IMMUT-01.
